# Snipe 1.1.2
## ✨ What's new
- Photos to PDF now use the same page size by default, so sharing and printing looks clean. - New PDF page size choice: A4, US Letter, or Original. Find it in Converter settings and Quick Menu defaults.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Fixed PDFs where every page had a different size. - Fixed portrait photos turning sideways in PDFs. - Fixed PDF to PDF losing selectable text. - Photos make smaller PDFs with quality setting, screenshots stay sharp. - Small icons no longer become huge poster pages. - Splitting a very short audio or video file no longer crashes the app — it now says the file is too short to split.

# Snipe 1.1.1
## ✨ What's new
- New Redact tool hides faces, text, or anything else in photos and videos. - Covers use solid color or blur, can come and go along the timeline, and faces and text are found with one tap. Originals stay untouched. - Trim, Split, Crop, Compress, Speed, and Redact work on webm, mpg, and ogv too.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Converting and changing speed across formats just works — video-only settings no longer break sound or GIF output, sound quality applies to videos, and MP3 speed works. - Clean Meta also removes cover photos and reviewer names in documents. - Cleaning PNG and BMP photos works again. - Edit Meta's Remove all clears everything removable and reports what stayed; it only appears where saving works.

# Snipe 1.1.0
## ✨ What's new
- Edit metadata - hold Option in the Finder menu, choose Edit Meta to change title, artist, and more for video, audio, and images. Only shows fields you can actually change. - Conversions keep metadata by default - names, dates, and locations carry over. Turn it off in the converter or under Settings → Quick Menu → Defaults. - Finder conversions use your settings - pick quality, size, sound, and more once in Settings → Quick Menu → Defaults, and every quick conversion from Finder follows them. - A menu that matches Finder - cleaner to read, with Regular or Clear style on the latest macOS. Clearer tick when you point at a choice, with separate sound and vibration switches in Settings. - Edit several files side by side - each file opens its own window. Instant actions like Mute or Clean Meta won't close what you're editing.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Clicking the menu no longer changes your Finder selection. - No more faint box around the menu on dark backgrounds.
